links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified ARS and AAFPRS patient handouts
links.outcome: Readability metrics and PEMAT understandability/actionability of patient handouts
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease 70.8 vs 43.9 (P < .05); Gunning Fog 10.2 vs 14.42 (P < .05); SMOG 9.9 vs 13.1 (P < .05); Coleman-Liau 8.8 vs 12.6 (P < .05); ARI 8.2 vs 10.7 (P = .06); PEMAT understandability 91 vs 74% (P < .05); actionability 42 vs 34% (P = .15)
links.tradeoff: Revised handouts averaged a seventh-grade level, not the 6th-grade target; actionability did not significantly improve; ARI difference not significant.
links.quote: LLM-revised handouts had better readability in nearly all metrics tested: Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease (70.8 vs 43.9; P < .05), Gunning Fog Score (10.2 vs 14.42; P < .05), Simple Measure of Gobbledygook (9.9 vs 13.1; P < .05), Coleman-Liau (8.8 vs 12.6; P < .05), and Automated Readability Index (8.2 vs 10.7; P = .06).
